Smt. Meenakshi Malhotra joined the Life Insurance Corporation of India (Corporation) in the year 1993 in the New Business & Actuarial Department at Northern Zonal Office. She joined the Actuarial Core Group team of Corporation, Central Office in the year 2005 and qualified as Fellow Member of Institute of Actuaries in the year 2008. She is a graduate in BSc Honours in Mathematics from Delhi University and Fellow Actuary from both Institute of Actuaries India and Institute & Faculty of Actuaries UK. She has been the Actuary involved in the design and pricing of various products of Corporation since 2005 and took over the responsibilities as the youngest Designated Actuary of the Corporation in the role of Product Actuary in January 2017. In this role she was involved in design, pricing, filing, launch and review of all the products of the Corporation till May 2022. She has also been actively involved in preparation of actuarial works related to the IPO of Corporation in May 2022. She has participated in various conferences, seminars and workshops in India and overseas and has been an examiner as well as visiting faculty at various Insurance Institutes on the subjects related to actuarial science and risk management. She has also been a member of various working groups formed by the Authority. She brings in an experience of over three decades in diverse domains of life insurance including on product pricing, actuarial valuation, reinsurance and underwriting. In May 2022, she took over as the Designated Actuary in the role of Valuation Actuary of Corporation, discharging various responsibilities to support and coordinate in preparation, management and filing of periodical statutory valuations and various other functions related to it. She is currently Chief (Actuarial/ Valuation Actuary) since April 2026, in the cadre of Zonal Manager.
